title: I CAN Program: 2025 Year in Review
body:
2025 was the biggest year in the I CAN Program's history. We ran sessions at four Toledo parks across eight weeks this summer, serving 68 youth — a 15% increase from 2024.

By the Numbers

68 youth enrolled. 5 partner schools. 22 volunteer coaches. 100% of participants received free equipment. 3 youth placed in regional competitions. 0 programs canceled due to budget constraints.

Our life-skills curriculum, developed in partnership with Toledo Public Schools, ran alongside every skating session. Topics included goal-setting, conflict resolution, financial literacy, and wellness. Attendance at the life-skills sessions was voluntary — 82% of participants chose to attend.

Looking Ahead

In 2026 we plan to expand I CAN to a second cohort running in the fall semester. If you're a school counselor, coach, or community leader interested in partnering, reach out to us via the contact page.
